method: Both complete pinned Kotlin files read in bounded, untruncated chunks (2142 lines). Cross-read confirmation handling in already reviewed SyncViewModel. Static Compose/flow review only.
findings: DuplicateGroupItem delete icon immediately invokes deleteFileOnPC(path,recycleBin=true), with no confirmation in duplicate branch. Ordinary search result delete opens AlertDialog. Desktop implementation previously reviewed always uses recycle=true; wording Delete permanently in ordinary dialog conflicts with its own Recycle Bin explanation and actual request.

Duplicate dialog displays Run Scan only when groups empty; nonempty result branch has no rescan/clear command. Closing/reopening retains ViewModel groups. No per-delete busy disable or local group/member removal. Generic successful confirm only shows actionMessage, does not refresh search/duplicates. Repeated click can issue requests against already removed file; stale listing concern, no actual deletion performed.

Duplicate header uses fileCount while enumerating only group.files, without truncation disclosure here. Desktop previously caps visible members80 and groups200. Header can claim more copies than listed; no complete-corpus coverage promise justified by UI.

Duplicate help says all mapped NTFS drives and above50MB; actual native scanner scope/caps from previous audits govern. UI does not prove all drives, scan completeness, or stated under3s/million-files performance.

Search dispatches on every edit/filter with no debounce or per-request generation. Blank query main content shows volumes, so late search response after clearing is hidden there; nonempty query/filter changes remain able to display older responses. Narrowing v62: cleared-query late result is not automatically visible in results branch.

Load More adds100 indefinitely locally but desktop clamps requested limit to1000. At1000 rows, next click requests1100 and receives at most1000; currentSearchLimit1100 hides button. No cursor or total match count is shown, so remaining results inaccessible through this control.

Preview rendering and save action only require fileContent!=null, not fileContent.path==previewFile.path. Shared ViewModel requests (including compact image fetch/pinning) can receive out of order. Save names bytes using current selected file.name. Compact action-sheet image and result thumbnails do check path, narrowing affected branches.

Compact sheet decodes full image bitmap on composition without bounds sampling; result-row thumbnail branch does decode bounds/sample toward80px, so not all thumbnails full-size. Video preview Base64 decode and cache-file write also occur in remember on composition. No frame/memory measurement.

Video preview uses AndroidView factory without update/onRelease; attach listener removes Handler callbacks on detach, but source here has no stopPlayback/release or temp-file cleanup. Do not claim playback persists/leaks definitively without Android lifecycle run.

formatSize units end atTB but index derived from log1024 is not clamped. Sizes >=1024^5 would index beyond units; nonpositive handled. No unchanged Kotlin control executed because kotlinc absent; static boundary finding only.

MainScreen gates Search/Pinned/Settings/Explorer/Themes and transfer cards with !isLocked, then overlays AppLockScreen. This resolves earlier unread UI gating in v61; does not establish bypass. Entry share/background ViewModel work is separate and remains subject to intended lock policy.

MainScreen lifecycle locks after remembered ON_STOP then ON_RESUME; source review is not device lifecycle proof. Transfer dismiss effects run independently of lock and use outgoing name/status rather than transfer ID; zero-size Completed/Downloaded progress computes0percent. Drag offsets are unbounded and retained across transfer changes, potentially leaving later card off-screen.
limits: No Android build, Compose UI, device tests, live requests, delete, playback, or user-file access executed. kotlinc unavailable; no Kotlin runtime result claimed.
No rrrah production edits; previous284 passed/2 ignored full no-default run unchanged.
